perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.SCM.obsCondIndep_weak_union` requires a `Causalean.SCM`, SWIG-node Finsets, and observed-variable projections, while S4 has locally defined rank coordinates under a generic continuous density law; it cannot instantiate this SCM/SWIG theorem. Use the generic `Causalean.condIndepFun_weak_union_of_prodMk` (or a local projection bridge) instead.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan the retained weak-union reuse in S4 and `thm:exact-ratio-decoder`: drop `Causalean.SCM.Do.obsCondIndep_weak_union`, whose SCM/SWIG abstraction does not fit the local latent/observed density world, and reuse the generic CondIndepFun weak-union lemma already exported by `Causalean.Mathlib.CondIndep`, supplying the required measurable coordinate-pair bridge.
